diagnosis.root_cause: The remaining release gates are blocked by reachability and evidence-window design rather than missing core systems. Ordinary play currently fails during first_toll at about 60.7 seconds, preventing five-wave, boss, victory-animation, and complete-run qualification. The passive performance sampler begins at final-wave entry instead of waiting for an actual 25–40-enemy representative workload. The diagnostic victory fixture also couples boss defeat to the automatic terminal transaction, leaving no stable post-defeat Cheer/lease state for inspection. This iteration should repair those boundaries and tune ordinary survivability, not repeat animation transform or clip-selection work.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or alter the preserved Warden, cemetery, Montserrat presentation, automatic-combat ownership, or semantic victory recording unless new candidate-bound evidence proves a package-level defect.
Do not weaken the release profile below five ordered waves, all four ordinary roles, the two-phase Bellkeeper, three weapon families, or the 25–40-enemy representative range.
Do not label diagnostic preparation, software-renderer timing, or an accelerated victory branch as ordinary-run or designated-machine qualification.
Stop balance changes and report the conflict if ordinary completion can only be achieved by moving victory outside 420–600 seconds or removing meaningful final-wave pressure.
If representative hardware is unavailable, retain truthful renderer and workload receipts and leave formal performance qualification to the host and Tester.
